newsitem.title: USA: Emisphere withdraws 2.5 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Emisphere withdraws 2.5 mln share offering.

text.p: Emisphere Technologies Inc on Wednesday said it has withdrawn its previously announced secondary offering of 2.5 million common shares due to current market conditions.

"We are disappointed that the current market did not afford the company an opportunity to complete an offering at a price that the company believes adequately reflects fair value," said Michael Goldberg, chairman and chief executive of Emisphere. Emisphere is a drug delivery company focused on the discovery and application of proprietary synthetic chemical compounds.
